---
title: "Compare logistic vs. random forest"
author: Casey Breen
---

## summary 

Fit logistic regression and random forest models. Compare AUC-ROC metrics. 


```{r}
## set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(47)  

## library packages 
library(here)
source(here("code", "helpers.R")) ## library all packages for analysis 

## read in death file 
death_file <- read_dta(here("data", "analysis_files", "nfhs5_deaths.DTA")) %>% 
  filter(months_since_death > 3) %>% 
  mutate(registered = as.factor(registered))

## cleam up variable 
death_file <- death_file %>% 
  mutate(facility_distance_quantile = ntile(facility_distance, n = 5)) %>% 
  mutate(road_length_km_quantile = ntile(road_length_km, n = 5))
  
death_file <- death_file %>% 
  filter(!is.na(area_km2)) 

death_file <- death_file %>% 
  mutate(state_factor = as_factor(state))
```




```{r}
set.seed(12)  # Setting seed for reproducibility

## sample splits 
death_file_split <- initial_split(death_file, 0.75)

training_sample <- training(death_file_split)
test_sample  <- testing(death_file_split)
```



```{r}
## formula 
formula <- as.formula(paste("registered ~", paste(vars, collapse = " + ")))


log_reg_spec <- logistic_reg() %>% 
  set_engine("glm") %>% 
  set_mode("classification")

rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = 500, min_n = 5) %>% 
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE) %>% 
  set_mode("classification")

# Define a recipe (adjust predictors as needed)
my_recipe <- recipe(formula, data = death_file) %>% 
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>% 
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

# Define a recipe (adjust predictors as needed)
my_recipe_lm <- recipe(registered ~ state_factor + wealth_quintile + female + highest_education + death_age, data = death_file) %>% 
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>% 
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

# Create workflows
log_reg_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(log_reg_spec) %>%
  add_recipe(my_recipe)

rf_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec) %>%
  add_recipe(my_recipe)

# Define cross-validation folds
folds <- vfold_cv(death_file, v = 10)

# Define metrics (including AUC-ROC)
metrics <- metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity)

# Fit resamples for both models
log_reg_res <- log_reg_wf %>%
  fit_resamples(resamples = folds, control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE), metrics = metrics)

rf_res <- rf_wf %>%
  fit_resamples(resamples = folds, control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE), metrics = metrics)

# Collect metrics
log_reg_metrics <- collect_metrics(log_reg_res)
rf_metrics <- collect_metrics(rf_res)

# Compare AUC-ROC
print(log_reg_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "roc_auc"))
print(rf_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "roc_auc"))

```

 

```{r}
## collect predictions 
preds_lm <- collect_predictions(log_reg_res)
preds_rf<- collect_predictions(rf_res)

## registered 
preds_lm <- preds_lm %>% 
  mutate(registered = factor(registered, levels = c("0", "1"))) %>% 
  mutate(registered = relevel(as.factor(registered), ref = "1"))


preds_rf <- preds_rf %>% 
  mutate(registered = factor(registered, levels = c("0", "1"))) %>% 
  mutate(registered = relevel(as.factor(registered), ref = "1"))

## 
roc_data_rf <- roc_curve(preds_rf, truth = registered, .pred_1)
auc_val_rf <- roc_auc(preds_rf, truth = registered, .pred_1)

## 
roc_data_lm <- roc_curve(preds_lm, truth = registered, .pred_1)
auc_val_lm <- roc_auc(preds_lm, truth = registered, .pred_1)


# Combine the data
roc_data_lm$model <- "Logistic Regression"
roc_data_rf$model <- "Random Forest"
combined_roc <- rbind(roc_data_lm, roc_data_rf)

# Define a colorblind-friendly palette
color_palette <- c("darkblue", "darkred")

# Plot both curves with color-matched annotations
roc_curve <- ggplot(combined_roc, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity, color = model)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.5) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgrey") +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) +  # Apply colorblind-friendly colors
  labs(
    title = "ROC Curve Comparison",
    x = "1 - Specificity",
    y = "Sensitivity",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.2, y = 0.95, label = paste("Logistic Regression AUC =", round(auc_val_lm$.estimate, 2)),
           color = color_palette[1], size = 5, hjust = 0.5) + 
  annotate("text", x = 0.2, y = 0.9, label = paste("Random Forest AUC =", round(auc_val_rf$.estimate, 2)),
           color = color_palette[2], size = 5, hjust = 0.5) + 
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(roc_curve, filename = here("figures", "roc_curve.png"), height = 7, width= 9, bg = "white") 
```
